material.description: Dispatching the instruction verb on /workspace/oscraft returned error_code none and 'dispatch panicked: Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime' (dispatch 1792902530072-5275-a07a6e3441d4e897). A later git_pull was then refused as long-gap-no-instruction, so a runtime panic blocks the git lane. Fix the nested runtime call in gm-mcp's instruction handler.

notes.note: Same panic text from a second verb: gm.codesearch({query:'non-2xx', mode:'dual'}) inside a gm_codemode body threw 'dispatch panicked: Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime' (dispatch 1792906346454-5662-8c944f28006e91b7, diagnostic codemode-877171-1792906346545-64). The literal call earlier in that body completed; the throw dropped the later calls. Literal mode is unaffected, so the shared path is the dual or instruction runtime entry. Filed by drain-gm-4.

blocked_by: gm-instruction-panics-nested-runtime-blocker-drain-gm-4. Fix already upstream (agentplug 085771db, in e17a906 pinned by gm main c3af980); served build still panics (dispatch 1792906578323-5331-b923e9fe52e1511f). Executor drain-gm-4 made no edit.

Same panic text from callers: gm.callers({symbol:"cas_retry_write_verified"}) and gm.callers({symbol:"prd_add"}) both threw "Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime" from gm-mcp codemode dispatch (dispatch 1792906382397-5092-a82029099df0736e, diagnostic codemode-877171-1792906382459-69). Callers verb shares the cause.
